headline: UP'DATED: It's the start of flu season and free vaccination clinics are back.
summary: It is that time of year again, time to roll up sleeves and get an influenza vaccine to protect against serious illness and hospitalizations due to complications from the flu.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
